description: ScholarBot is designed to assist users in extracting the number of publications associated with a specific professor's name and their affiliated university. It utilizes various tools to search academic databases and web resources to provide accurate and up-to-date information.

tools.name: SearchTool
tools.description: A tool that performs web searches to gather information about the professor and their publications.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to browse the web for academic articles and profiles related to the professor.

tools.name: DatabaseQueryTool
tools.description: A tool that queries academic databases to retrieve publication counts and other relevant metrics.

tools.name: APIClient
tools.description: A tool that interacts with external APIs to fetch publication data and statistics for the specified professor.
